people.name: Ernst Obermann
people.role: a bootlegger with the lease on the top floor

people.name: Konrad Hochstetter
people.role: a wine steward out of work since the Act

secret.description: Konrad Hochstetter hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Kitchen at 9:30 PM.

motive.description: wanted the victim out of a lease

secret.description: Carmela Ruggiero is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.

people.name: Francis Quill
people.role: a stringer for the evening papers

secret.description: Francis Quill goes through the papers in the Victim's Suite from 6:30 PM while the victim is downstairs.

people.name: Assunta Bellucci
people.role: a dentist with rooms on the third floor

secret.description: Assunta Bellucci meets the victim alone in the Victim's Suite from 7:00 PM and asks for money.
Delia Mulcahy slips out to the Street from 9:30 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

people.name: Agnes Sweeney
people.role: a photographer for the rotogravure section

secret.description: Agnes Sweeney is alone with Ernst Obermann in the Roof Garden from 9:00 PM to 9:30 PM, and kills Ernst Obermann at 9:30 PM.

coverSecret.description: Agnes Sweeney is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.

Ernst Obermann was found in the Roof Garden. The coroner puts death between 9:00 PM and 9:30 PM. Fractures consistent with a fall of six storeys. Two fingernails torn back.
The roof door key is missing from the Front Desk. The roof door was found unlocked and the key is not on its hook.
Rain began at 9:30 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
Konrad Hochstetter says Delia Mulcahy came in off the street at 11:30 PM with a soaked coat, so Delia Mulcahy was outside at 11:00 PM.
Bernard Sirkin says the bar radio carried the returns from the ward elections at 8:00 PM, and that the Ninth went the other way and the announcer said so twice. Anyone in the bar could tell you that.
Carmela Ruggiero's papers do not hold up. The registration card gives an address in Buffalo. There is no such street in Buffalo.
Agnes Sweeney's papers do not hold up. The registration card gives an address in Buffalo. There is no such street in Buffalo.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A lease assignment made out in Konrad Hochstetter's name, waiting only on Ernst Obermann's signature.
Bernard Sirkin says Ernst Obermann told Konrad Hochstetter the lease would go to somebody else at the quarter day.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A promissory note for $4,000 signed by Francis Quill, endorsed to Ernst Obermann, three months past due.
Bernard Sirkin says Ernst Obermann told Francis Quill that Friday was the end of it, one way or the other.
Found in the Front Desk: A subpoena naming Ernst Obermann as a witness before the grand jury, with Agnes Sweeney's name written in the margin.
Delia Mulcahy says Ernst Obermann said to Agnes Sweeney that a man who testifies sleeps better.
